mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% signals imminent monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises above 3.7% with >0.3pp monthly change.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 500,000 indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing output capacity and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO remains below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly real personal consumption (RSAFS) increase above 500,000 indicates sustained consumer spending strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 500,000.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment decline (PAYEMS < 150,000) and unemployment rate increase (UNRATE > 3.5%) indicate labor market weakness, reducing consumer income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS falls below 150,000 and UNRATE rises above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS below 2.5% during a monetary easing regime signals accommodative policy that lowers cost of capital, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5%.
